name: application-radio-groups
title: Radio Groups
description: Radio group input components for forms, settings, and user preferences in web applications with responsive, customizable designs.
useWhen: Radio group input components for forms, settings, and user preferences in web applications with responsive, customizable designs.
avoidWhen: Avoid radio groups when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Radio Groups uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
